principles.b: Cursor and Copilot scaffold; I review every diff with the same scrutiny I'd give a junior's PR. AI-generated tests get the same critique as the production code they cover.
The best component is one that solves a real, narrow problem well — not the one that anticipates ten unwritten ones. Premature flexibility is the most expensive mistake in frontend codebases.
Restraint in interface design, ambition in technical scope. The dashboard should feel boring to use; the architecture under it can be wild.
